notes: V_center is on its bound, so the data is not locating the D(V) minimum.

Sub-band width was held fixed at 38.92 1/V (FWHM 91 mV) rather than fitted, so each sub-band is one ideal one-electron site population and the DOS reads as a distribution of formal potentials. Fitted, this width is degenerate with the height profile and runs to whichever bound the grid imposes.

DOS is reported in states cm^-3 eV^-1 using the film thickness (0.0001 cm) and electrode area (2 cm^2) as supplied. Both are inputs, not measurements, and the absolute height of the curve scales inversely with their product - the shape does not. The integrated site density is an extrapolation beyond the measured window and should not be quoted as a measured density.

D scales with the square of the film thickness, which is an input here, not a measurement: at L = 0.0001 cm, a thickness wrong by 2x moves every D by 4x. The fast fraction and the slow/fast ratio do not depend on it.
